title: Implesta for engineering consultancies
description: Fixed-price and time-based engineering projects, planned by skill, invoiced by milestone, with margin per project. Built for engineering firms.
primaryQuery: project management software for engineering consultancies
teaser: Fixed-price and time-based projects, planned by skill, invoiced by milestone.
h1: Engineering projects that close at the margin you sold
lead: Your engineers work on fixed-price projects and on time and materials, often both at once. Implesta plans them by skill, invoices each milestone when it is reached, and shows the margin of every project while there is still time to act.
